pr.title: change help exit code to 0
pr.body:
Fixes #38 :-)

And also some people are bothered by the fact that the help function terminates with exit code 1: [reddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/golang/comments/f454o4/best_practices_or_tips_writing_a_cli_tool_with/fhyo8t5?utm_source=share&utm_medium=web2x)

linkedIssues.title: Help Option Exit Code 1
linkedIssues.body:
Currently if the the default `--help` option is used the app returns exit code `1`. I personally don't think that someone specifically calling `--help` should result in an exit code other than `0`.  Is there a way to change this behavior? I've reviewed the docs and Issues pretty thoroughly and can't find anything.

I'm also open to any rational that presents a good argument for why a program should return an exit code other than `0` for a user (person or automation) specifically calling `--help` as the only parameter sent to a program.

explanation.what: help.go の helpValue.BeforeApply() で、ヘルプ表示後に呼んでいた ctx.Kong.Exit() の終了コードを 1 から 0 に変更した。
explanation.why: issue #38 で「--help を明示的に指定しただけなのに終了コード1が返るのはおかしい」という指摘があり、リンクされた Reddit のスレッドでも同様の意見が出ていた。PR本文がこれを直接の動機として説明している。

highlights.note: Exit(1) → Exit(0) の1行変更。ヘルプ表示は異常終了ではないという解釈の転換。
